screenPanels.initJs: function(container, apiUrl, tables) { var transactionRows = container.querySelectorAll('.transaction-row'); var quoteRows = container.querySelectorAll('.quote-row'); var tabItems = container.querySelectorAll('.tab-item'); var detailPanels = container.querySelectorAll('.detail-panel'); transactionRows.forEach(function(row) { row.addEventListener('click', function() { container.querySelectorAll('.transaction-row').forEach(function(r) { r.classList.remove('selected'); }); this.classList.add('selected'); var detailLabel = container.querySelector('.detail-panel.active .detail-label'); if(detailLabel) { detailLabel.parentElement.parentElement.querySelector('.detail-value').textContent = '選択された取引情報'; } }); }); quoteRows.forEach(function(row) { row.addEventListener('click', function() { container.querySelectorAll('.quote-row').forEach(function(r) { r.classList.remove('selected'); }); this.classList.add('selected'); }); }); tabItems.forEach(function(tab) { tab.addEventListener('click', function() { tabItems.forEach(function(t) { t.classList.remove('active'); }); detailPanels.forEach(function(p) { p.classList.remove('active'); }); this.classList.add('active'); var panelId = this.getAttribute('data-tab') + '-panel'; var panel = container.getElementById(panelId); if(panel) { panel.classList.add('active'); } }); }); var searchBtn = container.getElementById('searchBtn'); if(searchBtn) { searchBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { console.log('統合検索実行'); }); } }

screenPanels.initJs: function(container, apiUrl, tables) { var qtyInputs = container.querySelectorAll('.product-row input.qty-input'); var productRows = container.querySelectorAll('.product-row'); var calculateTotals = function() { var subtotal = 0; productRows.forEach(function(row) { var qtyInput = row.querySelector('input.qty-input'); var priceText = row.querySelectorAll('td')[4].textContent; var price = parseInt(priceText.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')) || 0; var qty = parseInt(qtyInput.value) || 0; var rowTotal = price * qty; row.querySelector('.subtotal').textContent = '¥' + rowTotal.toLocaleString('ja-JP'); subtotal += rowTotal; }); var taxAmount = Math.floor(subtotal * 0.1); var total = subtotal + taxAmount; container.getElementById('subtotal').textContent = '¥' + subtotal.toLocaleString('ja-JP'); container.getElementById('taxAmount').textContent = '¥' + taxAmount.toLocaleString('ja-JP'); container.getElementById('totalAmount').textContent = total.toLocaleString('ja-JP'); }; qtyInputs.forEach(function(input) { input.addEventListener('change', calculateTotals); input.addEventListener('input', calculateTotals); }); var quoteListRows = container.querySelectorAll('.quote-list-row'); quoteListRows.forEach(function(row) { row.addEventListener('click', function() { container.querySelectorAll('.quote-list-row').forEach(function(r) { r.classList.remove('selected'); }); this.classList.add('selected'); }); }); var previewBtn = container.getElementById('previewBtn'); if(previewBtn) { previewBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { var previewArea = container.getElementById('previewArea'); var custName = container.getElementById('customerSelect').options[container.getElementById('customerSelect').selectedIndex].text || '未選択'; previewArea.textContent = '見積書プレビュー: 顧客=' + custName + ', 見積日=' + container.getElementById('quoteDate').value + ', 有効期限=' + container.getElementById('expiryDate').value + ', 合計金額=¥' + container.getElementById('totalAmount').textContent; }); } var saveQuoteBtn = container.getElementById('saveQuoteBtn'); if(saveQuoteBtn) { saveQuoteBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { console.log('見積を保存しました'); }); } var exportPdfBtn = container.getElementById('exportPdfBtn'); if(exportPdfBtn) { exportPdfBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { console.log('PDF出力を実行しました'); }); } var clearBtn = container.getElementById('clearBtn'); if(clearBtn) { clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { container.getElementById('customerSelect').value = ''; container.getElementById('quoteDate').value = ''; container.getElementById('expiryDate').value = ''; container.getElementById('remarks').value = ''; qtyInputs.forEach(function(input) { input.value = '1'; }); calculateTotals(); }); } calculateTotals(); }
